claude_proposed_widenings.name: passive_grant (class feature family)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Bonus Proficiencies is a permanent passive grant conferred at level-up. It has no activation cost, no use-count resource, and no reset cadence. The only existing class-feature family ('activation') requires all three of those fields, making it structurally inapplicable. A new family is needed for features that are permanently acquired at a level boundary with no activation mechanic.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You gain proficiency with three skills of your choice.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_proficiency in ClassFeatureEffect
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Even if a passive_grant family were added, the ClassFeatureEffect union (GrantExtraActionEffect | HealHpEffect) does not include proficiency granting. The v4 atom 'grant_proficiency' exists in the taxonomy but has no corresponding surface type in ClassFeatureEffect.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You gain proficiency with three skills of your choice.
